theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_nusc_flat_eventually
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S Dset : Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ (sub : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), StrictMono sub → (∀ k, z k ∈ Ss (sub k)) → Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 x) → x ∈ Dset → x ∈ S) → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (ρ ρ' s τ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), ρ' < ρ → ball w ρ ⊆ Dset → s < τ → (∀ y ∈ S, y ∈ ball w ρ → ‖(y - w) - Q.starProjection (y - w)‖ ≤ s) → ∀ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (v : ℕ → Euclid P), StrictMono σ → Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 w) → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ y ∈ Ss (σ i), y ∈ ball (v i) ρ' → ‖(y - v i) - Q.starProjection (y - v i)‖ ≤ τ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
